title: Bad Eden — Onboarding
description: Diegetic tutorial/onboarding flow. The Operator — a glitchy tutorial daemon voiced on top of Mal — walks new Stewards through incarnation, testing their meatsuit and rig, hex stewardship + the Turn cycle, and a hostile-hex finale (violence / intrigue / diplomacy raids) before graduating into live Bad Eden. Players practice on their REAL steward, rig and faction.
